rules.action: Moves into the tree (to the selected node, else the first) and out of it — one tab stop.
On a closed parent: opens it. On an open parent: moves to its first enabled child (disabled nodes are skipped). On a leaf: nothing.
On an open parent: closes it. Otherwise: moves to the parent.
Activates the node (onActivate, or follows href); with `selectable: single`, also selects it.
Selects (single) or toggles selection (multiple) of the focused node.
Opens every sibling of the focused node.
Moves focus to the next / previous node and adds it to the selection (the APG rule; no anchor range).
Selects every visible, enabled node at the current expansion state; bound by key code KeyA.
Type-ahead: moves to the next visible node whose label starts with the typed characters; the buffer clears after 500 ms (literal-ok, as Listbox).
